Item.Name: S_TO_COLL_DATE
Item.Hint: Enter to collection date [in DD-MON-YYYY format]

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 m_count number(5);
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
if :s_to_coll_date < :s_fr_coll_date then
 show_error('2136') ;
 check_package_failure ;
end if;
if :s_to_coll_date > sysdate then
 show_error('2138');
 check_package_failure;
end if;
select count(*) into m_count
from remote_test_units
where collection_date >= :s_fr_coll_date and
 collection_date <= :s_to_coll_date
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
if m_count = 0 then
 go_block('units_blk');
 clear_block ;
 :s_highlighter := ' ';
 :no_of_recs.count := 0 ;
 GO_ITEM('ctrl_blk_1.s_to_coll_date');
 show_error('2115') ;
else
 :no_of_recs.count := m_count ;
 go_block('units_blk');
 clear_block ;
 execute_query;
 :s_highlighter := '->';
end if;
 exception when value_error then
 show_error('9760'); -- It was 1706 HCL-C
 when others then
 handle_error;
end;

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY

begin

 :s_status_desc,:profile_test
 from remote_test_batch,master_codes where
batch_id = :batch_id and code_type = 'BSTAT' and code = batch_status
 and remote_test_batch.chapter_id = :s_chapter_id;

end;
